response.overview: To celebrate the release of his sixth studio album, Flop, Italian rapper Salmo published an immersive 51-minute video documenting a late-night drive through the streets of Milan. Originally broadcasted live to fans on Instagram during the album's midnight drop, the visual captures the artist cruising through the city while listening exclusively to the instrumental versions of all the tracks from the new record.
response.title: FLOP RELEASE PARTY (short movie)
